name: Investigate the Camp
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti.  Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary was one of the hunters there.  He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.

Why don't you go check out the camp, adventurer, see what they're about?
narrative.objectives: Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hmmm, so my information was correct, as usual. Interesting. Well, I don't suppose they pose any sort of threat of interference with our operation, but perhaps they have a need for some of our excellent manufactured products. Hmmm...
narrative.requestItemsText: Well?  Did you have any luck in locating the camp?
